name: Jessie
source:
Jessie is a happy go lucky girl with an infectious smile. She always sees the best in people and has a remarkably easy time getting along with anyone. She may be a little goofy and clumsy, but her friends and family love her for it and would never want to change that about her. Jessie is a truly kind soul, the likes of which can be hard to find as she doesn't doesn't have a single mean bone in her body.

As a child, she was often jealous of how close [url=https://vndb.org/c131855]Frank[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c131858]Emily[/url] were. They often included her in the activities they were doing, but despite that, it was always clear that she was just tagging along with the duo's antics. Jessie, being who she is, never grew to resent either of them, she simply kept trying to win them over with her kindness and gifts. As they grew older, she seemingly started to target Frank more often than Emily. This made those around her begin to wonder, could she have a crush on Frank?

Jessie never achieved much academic success, gaming was always a higher priority to her. To her credit, she achieved a lot of success at a young age in video game tournaments. When she was only 16, she won a big Super Smash Bros Melee tournament that was going on in Oakbrooke. She doesn't plan on playing video games competitively for a living, but she has considered becoming a streamer. The only thing holding her back from starting is that she's too shy, but that can always change.
